import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots to show comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_colors = {'Insomnia': '#e74c3c', 'Sleep Apnea': '#3498db', 'NaN': '#95a5a6'}
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    if pd.isna(disorder):
        mask = df['Sleep Disorder'].isna()
        label = 'No Disorder'
        color = sleep_disorder_colors['NaN']
    else:
        mask = df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder
        label = disorder
        color = sleep_disorder_colors.get(disorder, '#95a5a6')
    
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Sleep Duration'], df[mask]['Quality of Sleep'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=80, label=label, color=color, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)

ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax1.legend(frameon=True, fancybox=True, shadow=True)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_data = [df[df['BMI Category'] == cat]['Sleep Duration'].dropna() for cat in bmi_order if cat in df['BMI Category'].values]
bmi_labels = [cat for cat in bmi_order if cat in df['BMI Category'].values]
bp = ax2.boxplot(bmi_data, labels=bmi_labels, patch_artist=True, notch=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], ['#2ecc71', '#f39c12', '#e74c3c']):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax2.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Duration by BMI', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y', linestyle='--')

# 3. Stress Level vs Physical Activity Level
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', 
                     s=60, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity\n(colored by Sleep Quality)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax4.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(occupation_sleep)))
ax4.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax4.axvline(x=df['Sleep Duration'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, alpha=0.7, label=f'Overall Mean: {df["Sleep Duration"].mean():.2f}h')
ax4.legend()
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x', linestyle='--')

# 5. Heart Rate Distribution by Gender
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    gender_data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]['Heart Rate'].dropna()
    ax5.hist(gender_data, alpha=0.6, label=gender, bins=20, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax5.set_xlabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate Distribution by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax5.legend()
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y', linestyle='--')

# 6. Correlation heatmap of key metrics
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1:])
corr_cols = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
             'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[corr_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
            square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=ax6)
ax6.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax6.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=9)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
